summary: NVIDIA's data center franchise keeps compounding on AI infrastructure demand with mid-70s gross margins; guidance credibility and China exclusion are the swing factors.

pillars.title: Data Center demand keeps compounding
pillars.statement: Data Center revenue keeps growing sequentially as hyperscale and AI cloud builds continue.

pillars.title: Gross margin holds mid-70s
pillars.statement: Non-GAAP gross margin stays around 75% despite new platform ramps.

pillars.title: Networking is a second engine
pillars.statement: Networking grows faster than compute and becomes a durable second growth driver.

risks.title: Hyperscale customer concentration
risks.description: A handful of hyperscalers drive most Data Center revenue; a pause by one would hit growth.

risks.title: China compute excluded
risks.description: Guidance assumes no China Data Center compute revenue; policy shifts cut both ways.

openQuestions.question: How do Hyperscale and ACIE sub-markets split under the new reporting framework?

authorshipLabel: Demo-authored thesis anchored to NVIDIA's Q1 FY2027 release and Q2 outlook (8-K filed 2026-05-20). Not a real institution's view; not investment advice.
